name: klicktipp
description: KlickTipp toolkit: write, review and prepare KlickTipp email newsletters — drafts, block-by-block content, audience, sender, test sends and the dispatch confirmation — build and change its automations from a blank draft or a template, manage contacts, tags, custom fields and the opt-in processes of the account with their confirmation email, and read the statistics of its sends, tags and automations, over the KlickTipp MCP server.
